description: Create a Novence form on a project (optional — sites may use Formspree/Web3forms instead). Returns submit URLs for edge + public API.

fields.description: Field definitions. Empty array allowed; add fields later with update_form.

label.description: Visible label. Defaults to name if omitted.

name.description: HTML field name submitted with the form.

required.description: Whether the visitor must fill this field.

type.description: Input type rendered in the hosted form.

honeypot_field.description: Hidden field name used as a spam honeypot. Optional.

name.description: Display name for the form in the account.

notify_email.description: Where to email new submissions. Optional.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

slug.description: URL slug. Optional; generated from name if omitted.

name: create_form
title: Create form
